release_notes: Modern Integrations Card Hub architecture and Local Offer In-Browser IDE & File Manager. The Integrations page is redesigned into a dual-mode Grid/Card Hub (Vercel/Stripe style) with 25 categorized services, live real-time connection counters and balances, instant search, and dedicated 100% full-width detail configuration views without double-sidebar nesting. Local Offer editing inside OfferEditor now features a full-fledged in-browser IDE with file tree, Monaco-style code editor for HTML/CSS/JS/PHP/JSON, Find & Replace, beautification, live multi-device preview, image asset management, and upload/deletion operations backed by secure backend API endpoints with tiered PHP scanning and realpath containment.
